items.why: Riding the AI trade rebound with the Nasdaq up over 1% as AI-linked stocks recover ahead of key earnings.
Wall Street projects a down quarter for Tesla earnings but the stock is rebounding, and Elon Musk made headlines saying he is giving SpaceX stock to every kid in America.
Chip names are catching the AI trade revival after the rout, with the Nasdaq 100 climbing on renewed AI buying.
The fear gauge is unwinding as the S&P 500 and Nasdaq rally on the AI trade rebound.

summary: Stocks are extending the Monday bounce after last week's AI-led rout, with the Nasdaq up over 1% as AI-linked names recover ahead of key earnings and the S&P 500 following.
